recentItems.title: COSMIC KILLERS: Can We Survive a Comet Strike? | Full Episode
recentItems.description:
Are we living in the shadow of a lurking killer? Explore the terrifying reality and fascinating science of comets—celestial wanderers that brought the building blocks of life to Earth, yet possess the power to trigger total mass extinction.

In this full episode, we dive deep into the "dirty snowball" theory, the history of apocalyptic close encounters, and NASA's daring missions like Deep Impact and Stardust to intercept these cosmic messengers. We investigate the geological evidence of ancient impacts that wiped out the dinosaurs and search for the "smoking gun" of the Great Dying. From the chilling beliefs of the Heaven's Gate cult to the revolutionary physics of Isaac Newton and Edmund Halley, discover why these "harlot stars" have inspired both scientific wonder and primitive terror for millennia.

In this video, you’ll learn:

-The critical difference between comets and asteroids.

-How comets may have delivered 10% to 30% of Earth's water.

-The science behind "dirty snowballs" and the rocket effect.

-Why NASA has no current plan to stop a direct comet strike.

-The mystery of the Tagish Lake meteorite and its organic secrets.

recentItems.title: ALASKA'S DEADLIEST CRYPTIDS  | Marathon | Missing in Alaska
recentItems.description:
Uncover the dark mysteries of the Alaska Triangle in this gripping three-part marathon from The UnXplained Zone. We investigate some of the most terrifying reasons behind the thousands of people who go missing in Alaska every year.

From top-secret government experiments to ancient legends of vicious creatures, our team of investigators—Jax (former police officer), Ken (strange phenomena specialist), and Tommy (Alaskan legends expert)—brave the frozen wilderness to find the truth.

In this episode:

-The HARP Conspiracy: Is the High-frequency Active Auroral Research Program (HARP) more than just a radio research facility? We look into claims of mind control, weather modification, and its connection to the Aurora Borealis and local disappearances.

-The Alaskan Gnomes: Explore the chilling folklore of the Jinxyok or Iarak—small, powerful, and malevolent beings said to kidnap children and lead hikers to their doom.

-The Amarok (Demon Wolf): We track a legendary predator—a massive bear-wolf hybrid that haunts lone hunters in the Denali wilderness.
